fields.statement: At 044ec30f I read the diff df9cc6f4..HEAD: one resolver readyWorkflow (recorded workflow, else the [ready] rule for its kind, else ship-change) used by the daemon's ship pick (daemonShipOf For, daemonStart passes --workflow) and by run start on an existing change set via startWorkflow (explicit --workflow over all). go test -trimpath ./internal/api -run 'TestReadyWorkflowOrder|TestStartWorkflowExplicitWins|TestRunStartExplicitWorkflowOverRule' passes: recorded over rule over ship-change, and explicit --workflow over a recorded workflow, a rule and the default. go test -trimpath ./internal/daemon/... passes (TestPickShippedUnderDispatchedWorkflow). go test -trimpath ./cmd/rhiza -run 'TestScripts/(run-start-ready-dispatch|describe-golden|request-workflow-flag)$' passes: run-start-ready-dispatch makes a real bug change set (request --kind bug, plan run), and run start --dry-run with no dispatch file fails naming ship-change ('ship-change builds and reviews its leaves'), with [ready] bug = "bugfix" prints '- Workflow: bugfix', and with --workflow other prints '- Workflow: other'. Attempt 1's three findings are fixed.
